sectors.name: Agriculture & Dairy
sectors.tagline: Discover robots. Share problems. Build practical solutions together.

challenge.title: Affordable cattle-shed cleaning
challenge.line: Find collaborators · Offer a trial site · Share expertise
challenge.detail: Small dairies clean sheds by hand twice a day. This sample challenge asks for a low-cost machine that a two-person farm could run and repair locally. Collaborators, trial sites and know-how are welcome.

robotTypes.name: Drone sprayers
robotTypes.desc: Drones that spray crops from the air, covering a field in minutes with less chemical, less water and no contact for the worker.

robotTypes.name: Shed-cleaning robots
robotTypes.desc: Floor robots that push or scrape dung and wash the floor of a dairy shed on a timetable.

robotTypes.name: Soil and water sensors
robotTypes.desc: Small probes that report moisture, temperature and salinity to a phone so the farmer irrigates only when needed.

robotTypes.name: Weeding robots
robotTypes.desc: Slow field robots that find young weeds between crop rows and remove them without chemicals.

sectors.name: Education
sectors.tagline: Robots that help students learn by building, testing and sharing.

challenge.title: Low-cost robotics lab for a rural school
challenge.line: Find collaborators · Offer a trial site · Share expertise
challenge.detail: A sample challenge: set up a working robotics corner for under a fixed budget, using kits that survive heat, dust and power cuts. Teachers and makers are invited to share what worked.

robotTypes.name: Classroom assistant robots
robotTypes.desc: Table-top robots that read out questions, take attendance by voice and help shy students answer.

robotTypes.name: STEM robot kits
robotTypes.desc: Build-it-yourself kits with motors, sensors and a simple block language for Class 6 to 10.

robotTypes.name: Telepresence robots
robotTypes.desc: A screen on wheels that lets a student or expert join a classroom from far away.

robotTypes.name: Library and lab helper robots
robotTypes.desc: Robots that fetch books, label shelves or carry lab trays between rooms.

sectors.name: Healthcare
sectors.tagline: Practical robots for clinics, wards and homes, shared by the people who use them.

challenge.title: Reliable medicine delivery between wards
challenge.line: Find collaborators · Offer a trial site · Share expertise
challenge.detail: A sample challenge: a small cart that carries sealed medicine boxes between a pharmacy and wards without blocking corridors. Hospital staff and engineers are invited to describe constraints.

robotTypes.name: Disinfection robots
robotTypes.desc: Robots that disinfect rooms with UV light or spray while nobody is inside.

robotTypes.name: Medicine delivery carts
robotTypes.desc: Autonomous carts that move sealed boxes along a fixed route inside a building.

robotTypes.name: Telehealth carts
robotTypes.desc: A cart with a screen and a camera so a specialist can see and talk to a patient from a distance.

robotTypes.name: Rehabilitation aids
robotTypes.desc: Wearable or table-top devices that guide exercises and record progress for physiotherapists.
